person_note: The Goodreads quotes are gnomic and do not identify the narrator. The authorized sustained opening independently shows two base narrative modes: third-person chapters following the Tiger and first-person chapters narrated by participating protagonist Alex Cross. A series-level structural description and weaker interior summaries corroborate recurring villain/Cross perspective shifts, so the book is ALTERNATING rather than FIRST. Confidence is medium because the strongest title-specific prose evidence is limited to the opening and the evidence for whole-book recurrence is weaker.
